_comment: Manifest of expected pig counts per validation video. Filenames are free/descriptive (no need to embed the count). For a video not listed here, validate_on_jetson.sh falls back to deriving the count from the filename pattern template-validation-<N>.mp4 -> N (legacy compatibility). Add new videos here to decouple the expected count from the filename (e.g. two distinct videos can both expect 9 pigs without colliding). NOTE: JSON has no comments; videos intentionally excluded from a validation run are kept (preserved) under the 'disabled' key, which the validator ignores. Filenames follow the convention validation-<seq>-#<expected_count>.mp4 where <seq> is the file number (chronological order) and <expected_count> is the confirmed pig count. Counts confirmed by app output + visual inspection (except #103 which is unconfirmed).
